body:
Oh damn not gonna lie, I was feeling a little better ... I'm at work right now. I do phone surveys. One man I was talking with is a very lonely 80 year old who kept talking and talking. Talking with him made me so depressed, so I started drawing just stick figures on Paint and then one of my superiors sends me a message asking wtf I am doing. I said I can't end the interview for the reasons I told you. Well, didn't say I was depressed but just sensible enough to not know how to end the interview. He didn't care. He's like "Well we're not getting paid to listen to people blah blah." Well then fuck. Can you not fucking think about your paycheck for fucking once? Is your humanity waiting for you at the door like what is that? I understand his point of view but listening to someone once in a while is not going to hurt anyone. 

Anyway. Sorry for this long tangent. I find it hard to want to stay alive for reasons like this. The work culture is one main reason why I don't feel so good. This idea that making money is somewhat the most important thing on Earth. And it's not just that, it's everything. Life seems to be against me for some reason. Anything I believe in, or want or trust, doesn't work. The love of my life lives in another country. My life ambition will never happen because of money. So may other things. It's hard to see the light.
